summary: Iteration 27 - Invoice KPI Fix Verified: The P0 bug causing invoice cards to show '0' is FIXED. The root cause was in libs/redis_pipeline.py where execute_query() applied 'active: True' filter to ALL collections. Invoices don't have an 'active' field like opportunities do, causing them to be excluded. The fix makes base filters collection-aware.
